verdict.rationale: Numeral's own docs say it provides native integrations that calculate tax at checkout or invoice time and record completed transactions back to Numeral, so transactions flow in without custom plumbing. The pricing page also mentions connecting sales channels. However, the pack never names any specific billing system, payment processor, or commerce platform. The payment-processor mention in the platform transactions endpoint is a raw API feature, not a maintained integration. Missing for 10: named billing, payment-processor and commerce-platform connectors, evidence of maintenance and depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, there are maintained integrations for my revenue stack — billing systems, payment processors, and commerce platforms feed transactions in without me building the plumbing

citations.quote: Each integration handles tax calculation at checkout or invoice time and records completed transactions back to Numeral for filing and nexus monitoring.
Numeral provides native integrations for the platforms your business already runs on.
You can connect your sales channels and receive a free nexus study
